pebble.notes: חצצים villager, NEW Tripo gen. Mixamo humanoid (65 joints, root 'Armature'), stay-in-place clips. Bind pose T-pose: x ±0.5 is arm span. Faces +Z. No get-up preset in Tripo: play 'fall' then crossfade to 'idle' (or play 'fall' reversed). 'dig' (16 s) = build/work loop. Tint material.color for variety.

scientist.notes: Wegener-style explorer-scientist (fur parka, moustache, satchel + map), NEW Tripo gen. Mixamo humanoid, stay-in-place. Bind pose T-pose x ±0.5. Faces +Z. Use the same GLB tinted (e.g. darker parka) for the critic NPC; 'fold_arms' / 'complain_01' suit the critic.

dog.notes: REUSED from slope-sled (owned Tripo gen). Quadruped rig, only clip is walk. HEAD POINTS -X: rotate +π/2 about Y to face +Z. Idle = walk paused/slow; bark/run = walk with timeScale 1.8-2.2 plus procedural hop.

house.notes: REUSED from ph-rangers (owned Tripo gen): cream limestone Galilee house, flat roof, turquoise door (+Z). Ordinary (non-413) house; collapses procedurally (rigid chunks / squash + dust).

house413.notes: NEW Tripo gen: reinforced earthquake-proof house: cream limestone blocks, grey concrete corner columns + roof beam, dark steel X braces on the side walls, flat roof with parapet + water tank, turquoise door (+Z), green shield plaque. Pair with a procedural floating green '413' shield badge.

seismograph.notes: NEW Tripo gen: open-front wooden shed on stone base with brass drum seismograph (red zig-zag), dish + antenna on roof. Front faces +Z. Animate the drum/pen procedurally if wanted (single mesh, so overlay a procedural trace).

warning_tower.notes: NEW Tripo gen: cream limestone tsunami/quake warning tower with red-white siren horn, orange lamp, antenna, green shield, arched door (+Z). Includes a small grass disc at its base (sink slightly into terrain).

hot_spring.notes: NEW Tripo gen: basalt/orange-mineral rock basin with white rim crust, turquoise water surface, blank wooden sign and bucket. Add procedural steam particles.

ammonite.notes: NEW Tripo gen: golden-tan coiled ammonite on a cream limestone chunk. Scale small (fossil prop in strata / rock-hammer find).

observatory.notes: REUSED from frost-and-flame (owned Tripo gen): stone observatory with copper dome and a little snow on the base. Use as the volcano observatory.

boat.notes: REUSED from storm-proof (owned Tripo gen): small red fishing trawler with white wheelhouse and mast. Bow toward -X as exported (storm-proof rotates it by π).

rocks.notes: REUSED from ph-rangers: cream limestone boulder cluster (4.7k tris), good for instancing.

olive.notes: REUSED from ph-rangers: gnarled olive tree (ridge terraces).

cypress.notes: REUSED from ph-rangers: Mediterranean cypress (4.8k tris), good for instancing.
